entries.summary: The 256K window oversells it: retrieval accuracy at 128K is only 44.1% (vendor's own MRCR v2 number). Don't stuff the window and expect recall.

mitigations.note: Retrieve narrowly instead of filling the context — smaller, relevant chunks beat a full window.

entries.summary: Early reports of the Gemma-family habit: hallucinated names and specific details on general-knowledge questions. No independent hallucination benchmark lists it yet.

mitigations.note: Ground factual work until independent measurements arrive.
